title: Prospective one-day groundwater-horizon persistence of the blind LARE frontier
scientific_question: Does the blind short-horizon LARE groundwater-output frontier from C4R persist to 1.024 day under the same fixed-water-table laboratory semantics, without any closure, partition, timestep or parameter change?

authority.execution_source_reason: C4R Reference source. Repository reconciliation through current canonical shows no src/ or reference/ delta since this source.

physical_workload.history_selection: Frozen blind C4R half-offset histories; no new initial-state selection.
physical_workload.bottom_boundary: zero pressure head at fixed 160-cm laboratory lower boundary

prospective_boundary.rule: No C4V response at step >64 may be generated before this preregistration is committed.
prospective_boundary.prefix_identity_gate: R16 and R2 geometry, initial, state and node records for steps 1..64 must be byte-identical to immutable C4R authority after filtering non-prefix completion/history summary lines.

LARE.initial_projection: Exact conservative projection of the frozen finite-water-content profile onto each layer partition.

R2.route: Exact C4R/D13 accepted-trajectory Reference policy extended only in horizon.

FMC_SMVE.equations: Exact frozen D13 groundwater-front equations, 200 moisture bins, i=100 baseline, j=101..199 active fronts, nine equal substeps per observation.

fine_reference.role: Scientific reference trajectory for this bounded laboratory.

for_each_checkpoint: RMSE of total-storage error over steps 1..checkpoint
RMSE of cumulative-bottom-exchange error over steps 1..checkpoint
RMSE of terminal-bottom-flux error over steps 1..checkpoint
absolute mean signed terminal-bottom-flux error over steps 1..checkpoint
absolute final cumulative-bottom-exchange error at checkpoint
diagnostics: mapped 10-cm profile theta RMSE as non-gating diagnostic
upper and lower half storage errors as non-gating diagnostics
exact sign-change sequence and reversal-step differences without application tolerance
groundwater_horizon_vector.reason: Retains cumulative, instantaneous, direction and systematic-bias information without collapsing to one score.

comparator_relative_crossing.definition: At a checkpoint, a QUALIFIED reduced LARE member crosses a comparator only when every groundwater-horizon-vector component is no worse than that comparator within 1e-12 numerical equality tolerance.
comparator_relative_crossing.persistent_crossing: A reduced member persistently crosses a comparator only if it crosses at every prospective checkpoint 128,256,512,1024.
comparator_relative_crossing.exposed_step64_role: Reported and required to reproduce the C4R ordering, but excluded from prospective persistence adjudication.

H_GW_R4_PERSISTS.prior: C4R minimum reduced LARE dimension crossing both R2 and FMC on the GW vector is R4.
H_GW_R4_PERSISTS.test: R4 persistently crosses both R2 and FMC at all prospective checkpoints.

H_ACTIVE_LOWER_ZONE_PERSISTS.prior: C4R R6/R8/R12 have near-identical GW balance/flux fidelity while profile fidelity continues to improve with dimension.
H_ACTIVE_LOWER_ZONE_PERSISTS.test: Report R6/R8/R12 horizon-vector separation and profile diagnostics without introducing a tolerance.

H_NO_LONG_HORIZON_BIAS_REVERSAL.test: Report the sign and magnitude of mean bottom-flux error and final cumulative exchange error at every prospective checkpoint; no compensating-error acceptance is allowed.

decision_logic.C4V_R4_ONE_DAY_GW_FRONTIER_PERSISTS: All hard gates pass; R4 persistently crosses both R2 and FMC at all prospective checkpoints.
decision_logic.C4V_HIGHER_DIMENSION_GW_FRONTIER_PERSIST: All hard gates pass; R4 does not persistently cross both comparators, but at least one of R5,R6,R8,R12 does.
decision_logic.C4V_ONLY_R2_RELATIVE_GW_FRONTIER_PERSIST: All hard gates pass; at least one reduced LARE member persistently crosses R2 but none persistently crosses FMC.
decision_logic.C4V_ONE_DAY_REDUCED_GW_FRONTIER_NOT_PRES: All hard gates pass but no reduced LARE member persistently crosses R2.
decision_logic.C4V_REFERENCE_OR_REPRESENTATION_DOMAIN_B: Any Reference, prefix, FMC reproduction, LARE R16 control or fail-closed integrity gate fails.

interpretation_boundaries: C4V is prospective beyond 0.064 day but reuses the already frozen C4R initial states and representations.
Comparator-relative persistence is not application acceptance.
The fixed zero-head bottom boundary is laboratory semantics only and is not claimed as coupled-groundwater application authority.
No new absolute tolerance, weighted score or application decision threshold is introduced.
No cost or speed measurement is performed in C4V.
Failure of R4 does not authorize closure retuning; it changes the demonstrated dimension/horizon envelope.
next_if_positive: Preserve the smallest persistently crossing GW candidate and wait for externally qualified application-accuracy authority or test another independently preregistered physical/horizon axis.
next_if_negative: Return to representation selection or restrict the demonstrated horizon; no post-hoc tuning.
